'''Kharroh''' was a [[Gundark/Legends|Gundark]] that lived at the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It was available for selling as a pet.

==Behind the scenes==
Kharroh is a [[:w:c:cwa:Companion|companion]] for players of the online game [[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)|''Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures'']]. It can be bought for 350 [[:w:c:cwa:Station Cash|Station Cash]].
